about: A list variable of texts, list<string[4]>[3] (docs/adr/0086, section 7.3): appended to from a text variable and from a literal, each element held to four UTF-8 bytes as a string[4] variable is, so a longer text appends nothing and raises error.execution, as an append to a full list does; measured by len(), read by an index that is checked against the length, walked by a <foreach> and emptied by <sce:clear>. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: an empty list holds no element at index 0: nothing is read and error.execution says so
`hello` is five bytes and an element holds four: nothing is appended, the block ends before `count` is written
four bytes is the bound, and fits
the list holds its three: nothing is appended and error.execution says so
the walk reads each element as a text: 2 + 4 + 2 bytes
index 3 is not below the length 3: nothing is read and `first` keeps what it held
<sce:clear> empties the list; `count` is only written by the next append
